name: Google Drive
author: VanillaGreen
description: Keep folders in step with Google Drive.

requirements.purpose: Runs the sync and reads its status
Syncs files to and from Google Drive
Lets only one sync of a folder pair run at a time
Runs the sync every hour while you are logged in
Holds the sign-in notice until you log in
Reads the Google Drive keys from the keyring
Tells you when the Google Drive sync needs you
Reads the name of the Google account you sign in with
Asks the setup questions in the setup window

reset-pairs.title: Start the folder pair list again

twoWaySync.label: Two-way sync
twoWaySync.description: On: changes and removals on either side update the other. Off: newer files copy both ways, and removed files come back.
twoWaySync.info:
Local removals go to Drive Trash. Drive removals stay in local recovery.
If a folder needs setup, select Set up two-way sync and confirm the preview.
Changing this switch changes no files. Paused folder pairs stay paused.
A copy-only run requires setup again before two-way sync.
After an update, existing folder pairs stay in copy-only mode unless you saved a choice.

setupGuide.title: Google Drive needs keys from your own Google account
setupGuide.text: It is free and takes about 5 minutes in Google Cloud.

sync.label: Google Drive sync
sync.info:
With two-way sync on, ordinary-file moves, renames and removals update both folders.
Local removals go to Drive Trash.
Drive removals and replaced local versions stay in recovery for 30 days.
If setup is needed, select Set up two-way sync and confirm the preview.
With two-way sync off, newer files copy both ways and removed files return at the next sync.

pairs.label: Folder pairs
pairs.hint: Each pair keeps one Google Drive folder and one folder on this computer the same. Removing a pair stops its sync and deletes no files.

cloudKeys.label: Google Cloud keys
cloudKeys.hint: Paste the two keys of your Google Cloud client. VGS keeps them in your keyring.
cloudKeys.info:
Google Drive uses a client from your own Google Cloud account.
Create its Client ID and Client secret with the guide at the top of this tab.

connection.label: Sign in to Google
connection.hint: Google opens in your browser and asks you to allow access to Google Drive
connection.info:
Signing in lets VGS read and change your Google Drive files. It syncs only your folder pairs.
With two-way sync, local removals go to Drive Trash.
Signing in changes no synced files.
Google has not verified your own app. Select Advanced, then Go to VGS to continue.

firstPair.label: First folder pair
firstPair.hint: Choose the first folders to keep on this computer and in Google Drive. The hourly sync turns on with them.

action.label: Start the folder pair list again

initialization.label: Two-way sync setup
initialization.hint: Sync stays stopped for folders that need setup until you compare them and confirm the preview
initialization.info:
Stop changes in both folders during setup.
VGS compares ordinary files and previews missing access files.
After you confirm, it moves unchanged Google document downloads to a separate folder.
Edited downloads, different ordinary files or duplicate Drive names stop setup. VGS tells you what to change.
